description: World-truth parameters for the telemetry generator ONLY. Detection, prediction and diagnosis code must not read this file; they use their own estimates in config/detector.json, just as a real ground system would only know datasheet values. Equations are in docs/DECISIONS.md section 4. Absolute magnitudes are scaled and do not match a real lunar rover; the relationships between channels are what matter.

environment.gravity_source: physical constant - lunar surface gravity, NASA Moon Fact Sheet
environment.rolling_resistance_source: team estimate - needs a terramechanics citation
environment.sink_temp_source: team estimate - drive housing heat-sink temperature held constant for PDR (see open question Q5)

drive_motor.note: Lumped at the wheel shaft (gear ratio folded into k_t and k_e). k_t equals k_e in SI units for a DC motor.
drive_motor.source: team estimate - chosen so copper loss is small next to shaft power (about 90% efficient), which keeps wheel_drag's temperature rise inside the NORMAL band

drive_thermal.note: Thermal time constant tau = r_th * c_th = 600 s.

battery.source: team estimate - shape of a typical Li-ion NMC open-circuit-voltage curve, 13 cells in series; replace with measured data (see calibration_slots)

loads.source: team estimate (avionics, radio and heaters drawn continuously)

terrain.note: Process noise on each wheel's load torque, modelled as a first-order autoregressive (AR(1)) random walk. Because it enters at the physical cause, current, speed and temperature fluctuate together the way real data would.

sensor_noise_sigma.source: team estimate - independent Gaussian noise added after the physics

quantization.source: team estimate (BMS reports SOC in 0.1 % steps)

calibration_slots.note: Leave value null until filled from real data. When filled, record dataset name, file and how the number was extracted in 'filled_from'. Nothing is downloaded by this repo.

battery_ocv_table_soc_pct_to_v.candidate_source: NASA PCoE Li-ion battery ageing data set

battery_r_int_ohm.candidate_source: NASA PCoE Li-ion battery ageing data set (impedance measurements)

battery_r_int_growth_curve.candidate_source: NASA PCoE Li-ion battery ageing data set

bearing_degradation_shape.candidate_source: NASA PCoE repository - IMS bearing run-to-failure set

sensor_noise_sigma.candidate_source: Bench measurement on the team's RC robot / stepper rig (HUNCH-approved data source)
